page.overview:
Who is Backblast?

Backblast is an expert on the tracking systems and warhead capabilities of anti-aircraft missiles. The epitome of grace under pressure, he's the kind of guy who stands his ground waiting for his weapon's lock-on tone even as enemy attack planes draw a bead on him.

Backblast was one of the Joes's support troops.
